_comment: Versioning matrix for nano-zyrkel binary + WASM cores. Consumed by the update-core reusable workflow in user repos to decide whether an update is safe to apply automatically. Read https://github.com/schlein-lab/nano-zyrkel/blob/main/docs/architecture.md for the full versioning policy.

v0.1.0.notes: Initial workspace refactor. Library + thin CLI separation, Plugin trait introduced. CLI surface unchanged from monolithic v0.x.

v0.2.0.notes: Layered SDK landed. New notify channels (Discord, Slack), new GitHub actions (GithubComment, GithubRelease), new fetchers (RSS/Atom, Sitemap, iCal — all quick-xml backed), new conditions (Threshold, Stale, JsonSchema, Diff). New core::introspect module + nano-zyrkel introspect CLI subcommand publish the full SDK catalog as JSON for the browser-based builder. CLI surface and library API stay backward compatible.

v0.3.0.notes: New HatType::Pipeline — generic distributed work queue orchestrator. Iterates through a manifest of items, polls an external progress API, auto-advances when threshold reached, notifies on milestones. Writes active.json for downstream consumers. First consumer: CrowdGenome (pangenome alignment across 686 GRCh38 tiles). Backward compatible: no changes to existing types or APIs.

v0.1.0.notes: Initial wasm-core release. Data layer (DataLoader, Filter, Aggregator, Stats, Search, Diff, Cache, Retry) plus Config + I18n. Visualization layer with basic charts (LineChart, BarChart, Donut, Tooltip), advanced (ScatterPlot, Histogram, Heatmap, SortedBar, Legend, EmptyState) and spatial (LinearTrack, NetworkGraph, WorldMap).

v0.2.0.notes: Layered SDK landed. New data primitives (Csv, DateTime, UrlState, Router, WebSocketClient). New viz-ui feature gate with Toast, Modal, Tabs, Accordion, Icons (~30 inline SVG), TextInput/Select/Range form bindings, Sortable, Markdown (pulldown-cmark), Easing + Tween. New introspect module exposes the WASM SDK catalog via the wasmSdkSchema() JS function for the browser-based builder.

v0.3.0.notes: New 'tools' feature gate: ToolRegistry for registering, lazy-loading, executing and piping WASM CLI tools (minimap2, samtools, bedtools etc.) via biowasm/Aioli. Supports file mounting, stdout/stderr capture, multi-step pipelines, and tool health status. First consumer: nano-zyrkel-crowdgenome.
